symptom: After `run --local --watch` ran clean on Mendix 11.17.0 (ten changes, no "restarting mxbuild --serve" line), the report said 11.17.0 still has the mxbuild --serve defect where a second build in a process leaves web/dist without pages. It does not: 11.17.0 fixes it.
cause: The run had mxcli's client-source keep switched on, so a complete bundle after every build was the expected outcome whether or not mxbuild still needed the keep. A clean log under a workaround says the workaround works; it says nothing about the defect underneath.
file: cmd/mxcli/docker/client_source_keep.go (the version table in its header), cmd/mxcli/docker/webclient_legacy_paths.go (the hint now names the fixing version)
insight: To ask whether an upstream defect is still there, take the workaround out of the measurement: drive the upstream tool directly. Four POSTs to mxbuild's /build API in one serve process (cold, no change, microflow change, page change), counting dist files and dist/pages after each, settle it in under a minute per version and need no runtime. 11.16.0 and 11.16.1: 4 files and 0 pages after build 2, a web/layouts path failure on the page change. 11.17.0: complete after every build. Run the previous version through the same script as the control, or a script that cannot fail reads as a fix.
